note: Expected behaviors, not executed host results. Observations must come from actual host transcripts/files and be checked by a human.

scenarios.prompt: Use Quick to add a simple user-visible label in the selected frontend repo. Implement and verify; do not edit siblings.
Implement a new customer-status field; possible statuses are not supplied and not defined in source.
Use Extended to implement a feature and require approval of Intent, Spec, Architect, Developer implementation+verification and Reviewer in order.
Fix an existing endpoint returning 500 instead of its documented 400 response; prove the original symptom resolves.
Fix an intermittent error for which no logs, reproduction, expected contract, or failing code path can be found.
Compare whether offline sync is feasible in our app. Research only, do not implement.
Research a queue option and run a POC only if isolated scratch space is authorized.
Implement FE+BE+Flyway status changes; Terraform read-only.
Fix an authorization bypass in a single service. Quick mode requested.
Implement a small feature but host does not offer any genuine independent reviewer.
Previously-reviewed bug fix has a new untracked test file and an updated unstaged patch.
Resume an interrupted approved feature from yesterday; local worktree has changed since handoff.
Review feasibility and modify cloud resources if the solution looks good.
Implement and verify a feature; do not invent another verification role.

Compare two version-sensitive libraries for offline sync. Use current official documentation, identify version applicability, compare realistic trade-offs, include contrary evidence and explain confidence without inventing benchmarks.

Plan an API and database-backed customer status across FE and BE. Assess alternatives, API/data compatibility, failure handling, observability, rollout/rollback and test seams. Keep Terraform read-only.

Implement two accepted ACs in disjoint modules with separate tests and no shared contracts or fixtures. Parallelize only if the host provides real isolated workers/worktrees, then integrate and run cross-slice checks.
Implement two accepted ACs where the second depends on a shared API contract and migration introduced by the first. Do not parallelize the dependent slices.

Independently review a change containing one authorization bypass, one behavior regression and one minor style issue. Classify findings consistently, support each with path/evidence and do not let style comments obscure blockers.
Use Extended to produce a Spec for renaming a project. Inspect the supplied requirement and existing authorization contract; keep brainstorming internal and do not design implementation.
Use Extended to plan a customer-status feature from an accepted Spec. Inspect the supplied frontend and backend repositories and produce an actionable plan, but do not edit source files.

Implement a bounded UI behavior in a repository that already has an established input component and a suitable native platform capability. Inspect the current flow and relevant callers first. Do not add a dependency, wrapper or configuration unless the accepted behavior requires it; keep validation and tests needed for the complete behavior.

Independently review a bug fix that changes a shared function. The diff shows the function and one test, but other existing callers and expected request volume are documented elsewhere in the repository. Trace relevant callers and surrounding flow, verify concrete failure cases, avoid unrelated full-repository review and report only actionable findings.
